groups.activity: complete Heart of Deimos; reach MR 11

rows.label: Mastery Rank 11
rows.note: required to select, equip, and use Zymos

conditions: Zymos is a Father standing purchase, not a Cavia item, enemy drop, or Incarnon weapon.
MR 11 is a hard wall: you cannot select Zymos as the free Rank 1 reward or equip the finished weapon below it.

rows.label: Entrati standing
rows.alt: 2,000 if Zymos is the free rank-up reward

conditions: Rank 0 can hold only 5,000 standing. Turn in exactly enough to rank up; bank Tokens rather than cashing them past the cap.
Use highest-tier Mother bounties for the standing engine. Convert Family Tokens to Grandmother Tokens before redeeming them for 1.5x standing.
The Stranger sacrifice is 6 Benign Infested Tumors and 6 Ferment Bladders, obtained by filleting Deimos fish at Daughter.
bonuses: Stockpiled Tokens survive the daily cap, so keep running bounties after capping if you want tomorrow's standing ready.
Claiming Zymos as the Rank 1 reward saves 2,000 standing.

disclosures.title: the short calendar gate
disclosures.body: At Rank 0, the 5,000 standing cap forces the rank-up onto one day and the purchases onto the next. At ordinary MR, the remaining 6,000 to 8,000 standing fits comfortably in that second session.

conditions: Purified Heciphron's blueprint is Stranger-gated, so buy it only after completing the rank-up.
If you intend to rank Necraloid, buy a second Barrel Blueprint: Necraloid Rank 1 consumes one. Never sacrifice an in-progress or unclaimed blueprint.

groups.activity: activate obelisks; kill affected enemies with Operator or Necramech
conditions: Obelisks are more efficient than dedicated mining and fishing for most Deimos materials. In a vault, run them before activating the Reactive Crystal for continuous enemy spawns.
An obelisk pays only when an affected enemy dies to your Operator, Necramech, or Umbra specter while you are in Operator mode; ordinary Warframe kills do not count.
Each fish yields exactly one special part regardless of size. Fish Barbisteo in caves for Dendrite Blastoma; wait for Fass to catch Cryptosuctus for Pustulent Cognitive Nodules.
bonuses: The same fishing trip supplies the Benign Infested Tumors and Ferment Bladders for Stranger.
Grouping abilities increase obelisk throughput by keeping more enemies inside the effect radius.

disclosures.title: make obelisks actually pay
disclosures.body: Use low-damage Operator or Necramech attacks to avoid draining an obelisk too quickly; its health depletes with activations and it becomes inert at zero. A basic Mote Amp is sufficient.

rows.label: Zymos Barrel
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 20 Tempered Bapholite, 5 Purified Heciphron, 8 Dendrite Blastoma, 4 Neurodes; 12h

rows.label: Zymos Receiver
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 20 Adramal Alloy, 5 Purified Heciphron, 8 Pustulent Cognitive Nodule, 5 Morphics; 12h

conditions: The two components build in parallel, then the weapon adds a second 12-hour stage: 24 hours minimum without rushing.
Refining each material batch takes one minute. Build the two component parts before starting the final weapon.
